title: Dataset Bias Mitigation in Multiple-Choice Visual Question Answering and Beyond

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the percentage of matched n-grams between candidate answer choices and the premise (image and question) to show that correct answers disproportionately overlap with the premise compared to incorrect distractors.

Measuring the intra-sample semantic similarity among distractors, and the dissimilarity between correct answers and distractors, using sentence embeddings (e.g., Sentence-BERT) to identify algorithmic shortcuts.
